fix_subject: Logs to be case-insensitive also at enable_logging callsite
pr_title: Currently `CALL enable_logging('http');` would succeed, but then select

labels.summary: CALL enable_logging('http') succeeded but stored the user-supplied lowercase name, which did not match the canonical log type name, so the enabled logger never took effect; the fix stores the looked-up canonical name instead.
